sentence: The _____ of the research findings was published in a leading journal.
explanation: DISSEMINATE → dissemination (se agrega -ion para formar un sustantivo que significa 'el acto de difundir')

sentence: The study provided _____ evidence to support the hypothesis.
explanation: SUBSTANCE → substantial (se cambia -ce por -tial para formar un adjetivo)

sentence: The _____ of the two theories led to a new framework.
explanation: CONVERGE → convergence (se cambia -e por -ence para formar un sustantivo)

sentence: Her _____ approach to the problem yielded innovative results.
explanation: METHOD → methodological (se agrega -ological para formar un adjetivo)

sentence: The _____ of the data revealed significant patterns.
explanation: ANALYSE → analysis (se cambia -yse por -ysis para formar un sustantivo)

sentence: The researcher demonstrated remarkable _____ in her field.
explanation: PROFICIENT → proficiency (se cambia -t por -cy para formar un sustantivo)

sentence: The _____ implications of the study were far-reaching.
explanation: THEORY → theoretical (se cambia -y por -etical para formar un adjetivo)

sentence: The _____ between the control and experimental groups was significant.
explanation: DIFFER → differentiation (se agrega -entiation para formar un sustantivo)

sentence: The findings were _____ consistent across all trials.
explanation: REMARK → remarkably (se agrega -ably para formar un adverbio)

sentence: The _____ of the new policy requires careful planning.
explanation: IMPLEMENT → implementation (se agrega -ation para formar un sustantivo)

sentence: The study's _____ was limited by the small sample size.
explanation: GENERALISE → generalisability (se agrega -ability para formar un sustantivo)

sentence: The _____ nature of the research made it difficult to replicate.
explanation: EXPLORE → exploratory (se cambia -e por -atory para formar un adjetivo)

sentence: The _____ of the participants was ensured through anonymisation.
explanation: CONFIDE → confidentiality (se agrega -entiality para formar un sustantivo)

sentence: The results were _____ significant at the 0.05 level.
explanation: STATISTIC → statistically (se agrega -ally para formar un adverbio)

sentence: The _____ of the existing literature revealed several gaps.
explanation: SYNTHESISE → synthesis (se cambia -ise por -is para formar un sustantivo)

sentence: The _____ framework was based on constructivist principles.
explanation: CONCEPT → conceptual (se agrega -ual para formar un adjetivo)

sentence: The _____ of the variables was carefully controlled.
explanation: MANIPULATE → manipulation (se cambia -e por -ion para formar un sustantivo)

sentence: The study adopted a _____ rigorous methodology.
explanation: SCIENCE → scientifically (se agrega -tifically para formar un adverbio)

sentence: The _____ of the findings to real-world contexts was discussed.
explanation: APPLY → applicability (se cambia -y por -icability para formar un sustantivo)

sentence: The _____ review process ensured the quality of the publication.
explanation: EDIT → editorial (se agrega -orial para formar un adjetivo)

sentence: The _____ of the phenomenon required interdisciplinary collaboration.
explanation: COMPLEX → complexity (se agrega -ity para formar un sustantivo)

sentence: The data was _____ analysed using advanced statistical methods.
explanation: QUANTITY → quantitatively (se cambia -y por -atively para formar un adverbio)

sentence: The _____ of the study was to examine the effects of sleep deprivation.
explanation: OBJECT → objective (se agrega -ive para formar un sustantivo que significa 'meta' u 'objetivo')

sentence: The _____ between the two variables was statistically significant.
explanation: CORRELATE → correlation (se cambia -e por -ion para formar un sustantivo)

sentence: The _____ of the research design was evaluated by external reviewers.
explanation: VALID → validity (se agrega -ity para formar un sustantivo)
